description: Minified JavaScript source code for Chosen, a jQuery plugin that enhances select box UI with search and multi-select capabilities.

classes.name: SelectParser
classes.description: Parses HTML select elements into a structured data format for Chosen.

classes.name: AbstractChosen
classes.description: Base class implementing core logic for Chosen plugin, including search, selection, and UI management.

classes.name: Chosen
classes.description: Main class extending AbstractChosen, managing DOM interactions, event handling, and user interface for select boxes.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the Chosen instance, binding DOM elements and preparing the UI.

methods.name: set_up_html
methods.description: Builds and inserts the HTML structure for the Chosen widget.

methods.name: results_build
methods.description: Builds the list of options/results based on the select element.

methods.name: activate_field
methods.description: Activates the input field for user interaction.

methods.name: close_field
methods.description: Closes the dropdown and deactivates the input.

methods.name: choice_build
methods.description: Creates a visual representation of a selected choice.
